thread:
leah: EchoHealth just dropped a ~60-question security spreadsheet + CAIQ PDF. They want responses by EOD Friday and called out BYOK and SOC2 sections specifically. Anyone able to own?

mike.se: I can start triage — need to confirm the PII scope and whether EchoHealth will accept redacted answers for the POC. @omar.security can you take formal ownership of the questionnaire?

omar.security: I can own it. I'll open a ticket and run through the controls matrix. Quick question: is the POC running on Dedicated/demo VPC or Hosted? That changes our answers for data isolation.

leah: POC notes from sales: will be on a Demo VPC with customer-provided test records. Buyer expects Dedicated-like isolation for the trial but hasn't signed a Dedicated contract. I'll confirm and report back.

secbot: Ticket PS-4821 created in SecurityTracker. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/PS-4821 :page_facing_up: :lock:

mike.se: For architecture answers, I have a scrubbed diagram for the Demo VPC we can reuse. Snippet/drop-in: ```diagram: demo-vpc-arch.svg (redacted)```

omar.security: Thanks. Two quick asks: (1) Leah — can you request a SOC2 summary or at least a statement if they don't have one? (2) Mike — can you confirm whether BYOK for the POC is achievable (and what the minimal legal/ops steps are)?

leah: I'll ask them for a SOC excerpt right away. Procurement called BYOK "nice to have" not mandatory, but buyer may press.

mike.se: BYOK for the POC is doable if we run the demo on Dedicated; on Hosted we can offer KMS-based customer-managed keys but it needs legal signoff and a short onboarding step. I'll draft a succinct answer for the spreadsheet.

omar.security: Perfect. Plan: I'll draft the controls responses, mark any items needing engineering/legal signoff as "requires signoff", and post a first pass by tomorrow noon. Anything we deem high risk I'll flag to sales. :white_check_mark:

leah: EchoHealth asked for an ETA to share with the buyer — can we commit to first pass tomorrow noon and final by next Tuesday?

omar.security: Yes, I'll set those dates on PS-4821 and update. Ping me if they accelerate the deadline.
